description: Defines a reference counting implementation with classes QuicheReferenceCountedImpl and QuicheReferenceCountedPointerImpl, including methods for managing object lifetime via atomic reference counts.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedImpl
classes.description: A thread-safe reference counted base class with methods to add, remove, and check references.

classes.name: QuicheReferenceCountedPointerImpl
classes.description: A smart pointer template managing reference counting for objects derived from QuicheReferenceCountedImpl.

methods.name: RemoveReference
methods.description: Decrements the reference count atomically and indicates if the object should be deleted.

methods.name: HasUniqueReference
methods.description: Checks if the object has exactly one reference.
